requirements.title: Ask af-impl for the unattended mode
requirements.rationale: The driver is the one caller that knows nobody is watching.

criteria.condition: `specrun` starts the session of an implement step
criteria.contract: the second argument of `claude -p` is exactly that string, with the package's `spec_dir` as `afspec` names it; every other argument and the environment are as before

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/loop_test.go, in the existing test of the session's command line: assert the fake claude's recorded prompt == '/af-impl .specs/01_… --unattended' and that the other arguments are unchanged

criteria.action: for any step that is not an implement step, start its session with the prompt it had before
criteria.contract: a reconcile's prompt starts `/af-impl --reconcile` and a repair's is `/af-impl --repair <issue number>`; neither holds `--unattended`

setup: the fixture repository and fake claude of internal/specrun's helpers
check.pseudocode: in internal/specrun/reconcile_test.go and internal/specrun/repair_test.go, in the existing tests of those prompts: assert neither recorded prompt contains '--unattended'
